pages.text: 苏州的夏天又热又亮，咘咘坐在客厅的地板上，手里抱着一个毛茸茸的小狗玩偶。那是Oliver的样子——黑白相间的边牧犬。
pages.text_en: Summer in Suzhou was hot and bright. Bubu sat on the living room floor, holding a fluffy toy dog in her arms. It looked just like Oliver — a black and white Border Collie.

pages.text: "妈妈，Oliver今天吃饭了吗？"咘咘仰起头问。Tina妈妈蹲下来摸摸她的头："吃了呀，宠物酒店的阿姨每天都会给他做好吃的。"
pages.text_en: "Mama, did Oliver eat today?" Bubu looked up and asked. Mama Tina knelt down and patted her head: "Yes, the aunties at the pet hotel make yummy food for him every day."

pages.text: 咘咘想起在深圳的家，每天早上Oliver都会跑到她房间门口，用鼻子拱门，"砰砰砰"地摇着尾巴等她起床。
pages.text_en: Bubu remembered their home in Shenzhen. Every morning, Oliver would run to her bedroom door, nudge it with his nose, and wag his tail — thump, thump, thump — waiting for her to wake up.

pages.text: 她记得自己蹲在Oliver旁边，把小碗里的狗粮一颗一颗放进大碗里。Oliver歪着头看她，等她说"好了，吃吧！"才低头吃。
pages.text_en: She remembered squatting next to Oliver, dropping kibble piece by piece from a small bowl into his big bowl. Oliver tilted his head and watched, waiting until she said "Okay, eat!" before he started munching.

pages.text: 傍晚的时候，Sam爸爸会带咘咘一起遛Oliver。Oliver跑得好快好快，咘咘拉着绳子在后面追，笑得上气不接下气。
pages.text_en: In the evenings, Papa Sam would take Bubu to walk Oliver. Oliver ran so fast that Bubu held the leash and chased behind, laughing until she was out of breath.

pages.text: 有时候Oliver会突然停下来，回头舔咘咘的脸。湿湿的、痒痒的，咘咘每次都会"哈哈哈"笑着躲开，但心里好喜欢。
pages.text_en: Sometimes Oliver would suddenly stop and turn around to lick Bubu's face. It was wet and tickly. Bubu would giggle "Hahaha!" and dodge away, but deep down she loved it.

pages.text: 但是现在，爸爸要在苏州工作，全家都搬过来了。Oliver不能坐飞机，只好留在深圳的宠物酒店里。
pages.text_en: But now, Papa had to work in Suzhou, and the whole family moved here. Oliver couldn't fly on a plane, so he had to stay at a pet hotel in Shenzhen.

pages.text: 咘咘看着窗外苏州的天空，小声说："Oliver，你是不是也在看天上的云呀？你有没有想我？"
pages.text_en: Bubu looked out the window at the Suzhou sky and whispered: "Oliver, are you looking at the clouds too? Do you miss me?"

pages.text: 在深圳的宠物酒店里，Oliver趴在自己的小床上，鼻子搭在前爪上。他看着门口，竖着耳朵，好像在等一个熟悉的声音。
pages.text_en: At the pet hotel in Shenzhen, Oliver lay on his little bed, his nose resting on his front paws. He watched the door with his ears perked up, as if waiting for a familiar voice.

pages.text: 晚上，NOMI抱着咘咘轻轻说："你知道吗？Oliver也在想你呢。每天酒店的阿姨都说，Oliver听到门响就会跑过去看看是不是你来了。"
pages.text_en: That night, NOMI held Bubu gently and said: "You know what? Oliver misses you too. The aunties at the hotel say that every time the door opens, Oliver runs over to see if it's you."

pages.text: 咘咘的眼睛亮了起来："真的吗？那Oliver一定等了好久好久了！"她拿起毛绒Oliver，在它额头上亲了一下。"等等我哦，我很快就回来找你！"
pages.text_en: Bubu's eyes lit up: "Really? Then Oliver must have been waiting for so long!" She picked up her stuffed Oliver and kissed it on the forehead. "Wait for me, okay? I'll come back to find you soon!"

pages.text: 咘咘闭上眼睛，嘴角带着笑。她梦见自己推开深圳家的门，Oliver冲过来摇着尾巴，跳起来舔她的脸。再过一两个星期，这个梦就会变成真的啦。
pages.text_en: Bubu closed her eyes with a smile on her lips. She dreamed of pushing open the door of their Shenzhen home, and Oliver rushing over, wagging his tail, jumping up to lick her face. In just a week or two, this dream would come true.
